snapshot.notes: Counts describe the checked-out monorepo, not the production database. Unrelated working-tree changes were excluded from the count and from the paper.

method.entry_file_count: Count regular files with .mjs or .lisp suffix directly inside system/public/aesthetic.computer/disks.
method.import_count: Count .mjs entry files containing a top-level line beginning with import.
method.hook_count: Count .mjs entry files with a top-level export line containing the named hook. This is a syntactic census, not a runtime trace.
method.line_statistics: Split UTF-8 .mjs source on newline, sort per-file lengths, and report median, 90th percentile, and maximum.
method.platter: Values transcribed from the rendered Research Platter and its last modifying commit. Production records were not queried for this paper revision.
